entry.label: Principia Cybernetica Web
entry.description: The project history reports a web server in July 1993 and an experimental adaptive semantic hypertext in September 1994. Its annotation guide describes a historical submission process; present operation was not tested. The server page explains that an [empty] node has a menu but no text.
entry.canonical_definition: A hypertext publication and conceptual network associated with the Principia Cybernetica Project.
